{"id":1768999143,"question_id":279,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"10 months, 1 week","timestamp":1757747218,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"119 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1768999143/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Perfect Squares","memory":"9.1 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int dp[10001];\n\n    int bymem(int n)\n    {\n        //base case\n        if(n == 0) return 1;\n        // if(n < 0) return 0;\n\n        if(dp[n] != -1) return dp[n];\n    \n        //ek case hum solve karenge baaki recursion kardega\n        int steps = 0;\n        int ans = INT_MAX;\n\n        for(int i=1 ; i<=sqrt(n) ; i++)\n        {\n            int square = i * i;\n            steps = 1 + bymem(n - square);\n            ans = min(ans , steps);\n        } \n        return dp[n] = ans;\n    }\n\n    int numSquares(int n) {\n        \n        memset(dp , -1 , sizeof(dp));\n        return bymem(n) - 1;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"perfect-squares","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":794}
